Age of Electricity chain layer: grid-equipment. Custom switchgear and packaged electrical houses for very large single loads. Long-run revenue CAGR hypothesis 12-18% over 10y; economics: lumpy-project-scarcity; evidence basis: issuer_release. Basis and falsifier in data/growth_estimates.csv.

Age of Electricity chain layer: grid-equipment. Medium-power transformers and cooling; sits directly on the transformer bottleneck. Long-run revenue CAGR hypothesis 8-12% over 10y; economics: cyclical-scarcity-rent; evidence basis: screen_inference. Basis and falsifier in data/growth_estimates.csv.

Age of Electricity chain layer: thermal-white-space. Applied cooling at building and campus scale. Long-run revenue CAGR hypothesis 6-9% over 10y; economics: quality-compounder; evidence basis: screen_inference. Basis and falsifier in data/growth_estimates.csv.

Age of Electricity chain layer: build-and-install. Mechanical and electrical construction; data centres a rising share of the mix. Long-run revenue CAGR hypothesis 7-11% over 10y; economics: execution-driven; evidence basis: screen_inference. Basis and falsifier in data/growth_estimates.csv.

Age of Electricity chain layer: build-and-install. Transmission and distribution contracting at small scale. Long-run revenue CAGR hypothesis 8-12% over 10y; economics: price-taker; evidence basis: screen_inference. Basis and falsifier in data/growth_estimates.csv.

Age of Electricity chain layer: grid-equipment. Electrical distribution and power management from the substation to the rack. Long-run revenue CAGR hypothesis 7-11% over 10y; economics: scarcity-rent; evidence basis: issuer_release. Basis and falsifier in data/growth_estimates.csv.

Age of Electricity chain layer: grid-equipment. Utility transmission and distribution components; grid-hardening consumables. Long-run revenue CAGR hypothesis 6-9% over 10y; economics: specified-in-position; evidence basis: screen_inference. Basis and falsifier in data/growth_estimates.csv.

Age of Electricity chain layer: grid-equipment. Enclosures and electrical connection; liquid-cooling fluid connectors. Long-run revenue CAGR hypothesis 8-12% over 10y; economics: share-gain-plus-scarcity; evidence basis: screen_inference. Basis and falsifier in data/growth_estimates.csv.

Age of Electricity chain layer: prime-movers. Nuclear components; naval propulsion today and small modular reactors as optionality. Age of Electricity chain layer: thermal-white-space. Power and thermal management inside the data hall. Long-run revenue CAGR hypothesis 12-18% over 10y; economics: share-plus-content-growth; evidence basis: primary_filing. Basis and falsifier in data/growth_estimates.csv.

Age of Electricity chain layer: thermal-white-space. Data-centre cooling equipment; a mix shift away from vehicular thermal. Long-run revenue CAGR hypothesis 7-12% over 10y; economics: mix-shift-in-progress; evidence basis: screen_inference. Basis and falsifier in data/growth_estimates.csv.
